text:
anya: Quick sync — I'm kicking off a small synthetic seeding run to surface edge-case prompts that caused hallucinations / truncation with the q4-int8 quantized candidate. Planning to curate ~2k synth candidates and hand off ~200 for golden labeling.

jordan: Nice. Do we have the failure modes list? want coverage across persona, instruction complexity, and long-context split.

anya: Yes — DEVON posted the failure spreadsheet earlier today (link in thread). Key buckets: multi-step planning, code-generation with ambiguous constraints, long-system+user context collisions, and scoring prompts that trigger low-confidence repeats.

sam: Proposed pipeline: generate synthetic variants using paraphrase + perturbation, embed + dedupe with cosine >= 0.85, then cluster and sample to maximize intent diversity. Target 2,000 raw -> 450 after dedupe -> pick 200 for golden.

lina: For dedupe, are we using the new cross-encoder QC or just embedding threshold? cross-encoder helps but it's slow.

sam: Start with embeddings-only pass (fast), then a lightweight cross-encoder rerank for the final 500. We can use the cheap quantized CE model for rerank.

anya: I'll generate the synth set. here's the sampler command I'm using:```bash
python curate_sampler.py \
  --seed 1930456789 \
  --mode paraphrase_perturb \
  --count 2500 \
  --filters "no-pii,lang:en" \
  --embed-model embed-small-v1 \
  --dedupe-thresh 0.85 \
  --out /mnt/curation/synth_runs/1930456789.jsonl
```

sam: looks good. for dedupe code we run:```py
# dedupe snippet
from pathlib import Path
from embeddings import embed_batch
items = list(open('1930456789.jsonl'))
embs = embed_batch(items, model='embed-small-v1')
# pairwise dedupe using cosine >= 0.85
# cluster -> sample 450 with stratify intent_label
```

devon: I'll attach the failure_modes.csv and intent priors to the run folder. also adding a small script to bias sampling toward low-frequency intents.

labeler-bot: Created labeling job #4837: "synth-edgecase-golden-1930456789" with 2,150 items queued. Expected first batch in ~30m. Assignees: @lina, @sam, label-team-A.

lina: On it — I'll grab the first 50 for sanity check, focusing on multi-step planning and code gen. If we see noise, we stop the job and adjust generation heuristics.

qa-bot: Plan: post-labeling automated golden audit (n=200) -> run evals against q4-int8 candidate and fp16 baseline. Metrics: exact-match variants, hallucination rate, and instruction-following score. Will produce a regression report artifact.

anya: Perfect. Timeline: synth generation + dedupe by EOD, labeling kickoff tonight, golden audit by tomorrow afternoon. I'll upload the seed tarball to /mnt/curation/synth-seeds/1930456789.tar.gz and ping labelers when done.

jordan: flagging one more thing — remember to exclude examples that match production PII rules.

anya: Yup — filter step is in the pipeline. thanks everyone :pray:
